title: ARCH-1 pre-registered criteria, committed before any Gate 1-5 run
candidate_set: RAG_BOUNDARY_ONLY final regions (tau 0.45) < 200 px, plus all canonical small instances for the merge-protection task

class_definitions_eval_only.PSEUDO: region < 200 px whose majority official instance is >= 5x its area
class_definitions_eval_only.TRUE_SMALL: region < 200 px with IoU >= 0.5 to an official instance
class_definitions_eval_only.INK_BAND_PROXY: PSEUDO with >= 80% of pixels within 1.5 px of UNIT_BOUNDARY and >= 60% on image ink (1 px) - a pre-defined proxy, not an independent ink-band annotation

tasks.T1_narrow_vs_ink_band: TRUE_SMALL vs PSEUDO, regions with predicted width < 10 px
tasks.T2_protect_from_merge: for canonical small instances whose best initial-region set is not mixed (Oracle A >= 0.5): separation evidence on the border to the absorbing neighbour vs borders between initial regions of the same instance
tasks.T3_absorb_fragments: PSEUDO vs TRUE_SMALL, all regions < 200 px
tasks.T4_large_integrity: RAG region borders inside one official instance >= 20000 px (false internal borders) vs borders between different instances (true contacts), for borders of regions >= 2000 px

gate1.width_groups: predicted width (own-mask inscribed width of the candidate region) <= 6, 6-10, 10-20, > 20 px; T2 / T4 use the canonical width of the instance only to GROUP results (evaluation), never as a feature
metrics: precision / recall / false-positive rate at the threshold that keeps 95% of the positive class (threshold set on training sheets)
class base rate in the candidate set
gate1.base_rate_note: base rates are of the RAG candidate set on these sheets, not of geological units on GSJ maps
gate1.independence: Spearman correlation between features over the candidate set, and correlation of ERRORS: for each feature the set of misclassified items at its 95%-recall threshold; Jaccard overlap and phi coefficient between error sets of different features; a pair counts as 'practically independent' only if error phi < 0.3

single_replacement.O_CONTACT: B2 pair strength replaced by official edges (1 on edges, 0 elsewhere) in BOTH over-segmentation and merge
single_replacement.O_NARROW_CANDIDATES: B2 over-segmentation + official instance masks of canonical width < 10 px inserted as hard cuts (their boundaries added to the initial partition); merge unchanged
single_replacement.O_INK_BAND: after the frozen merge, every PSEUDO region < 200 px is merged into its majority-instance neighbour region (perfect fragment discrimination)
single_replacement.O_MERGE_RELATION: frozen initial regions; merge only adjacent regions whose majority official instance is the same (Oracle B)
single_replacement.O_UNIT_CODE: merge cost +1 (forbid) between regions whose majority official UNIT (geo_A class) differs, and -1 (force) between same-unit adjacent regions sharing >= 50% majority instance; i.e. perfect class / code evidence

gate2.metrics: small recall per width group, merge errors, under-merge fragments, initial-mixed, pseudo-fragment count, large recall, Oracle A / B of the initial partition
gate2.keep_rule: an evidence type stays a candidate if its oracle improves recall by >= 0.03 in the <= 6 or 6-10 px group OR overall small recall by >= 0.01 OR removes >= 30% of pseudo fragments; never dropped on overall recall alone

gate3.synthetic_pass: on synthetic lines of known width 1.0-6.0 px (anti-aliased, angles 0-90 deg, curved, crossing, dashed), median absolute width error <= 0.35 px for widths 1-3 px and <= 12% above 3 px, and >= 90% of crossing / junction samples flagged as unreliable
gate3.gsj_pass: on the 10 training sheets + 13014 / 15076: (a) estimates on official contact lines (eval only) have per-sheet median within [0.8, 3.5] px and inter-sheet CV <= 0.35; (b) repeatability: same image twice identical; (c) scale check: on 15023 rescaled 0.75 / 1.5 the median width ratio within 15% of the factor; (d) discrimination: AUC >= 0.80 between ink-band-proxy pseudo fragments (single printed line) and TRUE_SMALL regions < 6 px wide (strip between two lines) using 'region width / local line width'
gate3.on_fail: LINE_WIDTH_ESTIMATOR_NOT_QUALIFIED; no threshold re-tuning; report which criterion failed
gate3.official_lines: used only for evaluation; never as input to the estimator

gate4.hard_cut_eligibility: only candidate boundaries from a generator whose PROTECT evidence has a measured false-protection rate <= 0.10 on training sheets may become hard cuts; in ARCH-1 no generator qualifies yet, so the study simulates with O_NARROW_CANDIDATES only
gate4.dedup: candidate boundary pixels within 1 pair of an existing B2 over-segmentation boundary are not added
gate4.limits_for_admission: regions <= 3x the B2-only over-segmentation; merge time and peak RSS reported; full uncertain-candidate geometry and evidence preserved after merging

gate5_admission.admit_C_PAIR_V0_1_if: Gate 2 shows O_NARROW_CANDIDATES raises 3-6 px Oracle A to >= 0.65 with Oracle B reported, region count <= 3x B2-only, AND Gate 1 T1 finds at least one feature or pair with AUC >= 0.80 (or <= 0.20) on both training and exposed sheets with error phi < 0.3 against B2 strength; otherwise 'not admitted' with the failed condition
